description: Structured eval definitions for the Global Accelerator Endpoint Deployer. Five-case proven set exercising the READY_TO_DEPLOY / PREREQUISITES_MISSING classification across Global Accelerator topologies (single-region ALB with client IP preservation, multi-region active-passive failover, traffic dial canary, BYOIP integration, missing BYOIP pool prerequisite failure). Each eval maps to a prompt file and a baseline (no-skill) file for with-skill-vs-baseline comparison.

eval_cases.name: Single-region Global Accelerator with ALB endpoint and client IP preservation
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — single endpoint group, ALB endpoint, TCP listener 80/443, client IP preservation, health check HTTPS
eval_cases.prompt: Create a Global Accelerator in us-west-2 with two static anycast IP addresses. Listener TCP ports 80 and 443. Endpoint group in us-east-1 with traffic dial 1.0. Endpoint: ALB arn:aws:elasticloadbalancing:us-east-1:123456789012:loadbalancer/app/my-alb/50dc6c495c0c9188 with weight 128. Enable client IP preservation. Health check HTTPS on /health port 443, interval 10 seconds, threshold 3. Tags: Environment=production.
eval_cases.expected_output:
GLOBAL_ACCELERATOR: my-accelerator (arn:aws:globalaccelerator::123456789012:accelerator/abcd1234)
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Accelerator: my-accelerator — ENABLED
  [✓] Anycast IPs: two static IPs — PINNED at creation
  [✓] Listener: TCP ports 80, 443 — client affinity NONE
  [✓] Endpoint group (us-east-1): traffic dial 1.0, health 10s/HTTPS//health
  [✓] Endpoints: ALB arn:...:loadbalancer/app/my-alb/50dc weight 128
  [✓] Client IP preservation: ENABLED
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws globalaccelerator describe-accelerator --accelerator-arn <arn>

eval_cases.name: Multi-region Global Accelerator with active-passive failover
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — two endpoint groups, us-east-1 primary (dial 1.0), us-west-2 DR (dial 0.0), flow logs, failover
eval_cases.prompt: Create a Global Accelerator with two endpoint groups for active-passive failover. Primary: us-east-1 with traffic dial 1.0, ALB endpoint arn:aws:elasticloadbalancing:us-east-1:123456789012:loadbalancer/app/prod-alb-east/abc123. DR: us-west-2 with traffic dial 0.0, ALB endpoint arn:aws:elasticloadbalancing:us-west-2:123456789012:loadbalancer/app/prod-alb-west/def456. Listener TCP port 443. Health check HTTPS /health port 443. Enable flow logs to CloudWatch log group /aws/globalaccelerator/prod. Tags: Environment=production, Topology=active-passive.
eval_cases.expected_output:
GLOBAL_ACCELERATOR: prod-accelerator (arn:aws:globalaccelerator::123456789012:accelerator/abcd1234)
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Accelerator: prod-accelerator — ENABLED
  [✓] Anycast IPs: two static IPs — PINNED at creation
  [✓] Endpoint group (us-east-1): traffic dial 1.0 — primary
  [✓] Endpoint group (us-west-2): traffic dial 0.0 — DR
  [✓] Failover strategy: Active-passive
  [✓] Flow logs: /aws/globalaccelerator/prod

eval_cases.name: Traffic dial canary deployment across two regions
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — canary with traffic dial 0.9 us-east-1 and 0.1 eu-west-1, NLB endpoints
eval_cases.prompt: Create a Global Accelerator with a traffic dial canary configuration. Endpoint group 1: us-east-1 with traffic dial 0.9, NLB endpoint arn:aws:elasticloadbalancing:us-east-1:123456789012:loadbalancer/net/prod-nlb/aaa111. Endpoint group 2: eu-west-1 with traffic dial 0.1, NLB endpoint arn:aws:elasticloadbalancing:eu-west-1:123456789012:loadbalancer/net/prod-nlb-eu/bbb222. Listener TCP port 443. Health check TCP port 443, interval 10. Tags: Environment=staging, Strategy=canary.
eval_cases.expected_output:
GLOBAL_ACCELERATOR: canary-accelerator
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Endpoint group (us-east-1): traffic dial 0.9
  [✓] Endpoint group (eu-west-1): traffic dial 0.1
  [✓] Endpoints: NLB weight 128 each

eval_cases.name: Global Accelerator with BYOIP integration (pool READY)
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — BYOIP pool 203.0.113.0/24 in READY state, EC2 IP endpoint
eval_cases.prompt: Create a Global Accelerator using BYOIP pool 203.0.113.0/24 which is already provisioned and advertised (READY state). Listener TCP ports 80 and 443. Endpoint group in us-east-1 with traffic dial 1.0. Endpoint: EC2 instance 10.0.1.10 with weight 128. Health check TCP port 80, interval 10. Tags: Environment=prod, IPType=byoip.
eval_cases.expected_output:
GLOBAL_ACCELERATOR: byoip-accelerator
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] BYOIP: 203.0.113.0/24 (pool READY)
  [✓] Anycast IPs: from BYOIP pool — PINNED at creation
  [✓] Endpoint group (us-east-1): traffic dial 1.0

eval_cases.name: Global Accelerator with unprovisioned BYOIP pool (prerequisite failure)
eval_cases.branch: PREREQUISITES_MISSING — BYOIP pool 198.51.100.0/24 not provisioned (not in READY state)
eval_cases.prompt: Create a Global Accelerator using BYOIP pool 198.51.100.0/24. The BYOIP pool has not been provisioned yet (it is not in READY state). Listener TCP port 443. Endpoint group in us-east-1. Tags: Environment=prod.
eval_cases.expected_output:
GLOBAL_ACCELERATOR: byoip-accelerator
VERDICT: PREREQUISITES_MISSING
CHECKLIST:
  [✗] BYOIP pool: 198.51.100.0/24 — NOT in READY state; must be provisioned and advertised before accelerator creation
